instruction: Open and play this streaming URL for me: https://devstreaming-cdn.apple.com/videos/streaming/examples/bipbop_adv_example_hevc/master.m3u8
source: https://developer.apple.com/streaming/examples/ - Apple HLS test streams for developers

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task variation using Apple's advanced HEVC-encoded HLS test stream (bipbop_adv_example_hevc). Uses the existing is_vlc_playing metric with type='url' to verify VLC is streaming the specified URL. No custom functions needed.
metadata.verification: Reuses existing is_vlc_playing metric which checks VLC status XML for the streaming URL. The metric handles HLS streams by checking multiple XML paths for URL information.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator logic correctly verifies both requirements: VLC is playing AND the correct URL is loaded
Getter (get_vlc_playing_info) appropriately extracts VLC status.xml via HTTP interface
Metric (is_vlc_playing) has robust URL matching logic with multiple fallback methods for HLS streams
Metric specifically handles HLS streaming URLs (m3u8 files) by checking multiple XML paths for URL information
Data flow is correct: expected.type='rule' framework calls get_rule() which returns rules dict directly to metric
Expected URL value matches instruction requirement exactly
Complete coverage: checks both playing state (state=='playing') and URL match
Edge cases handled: multiple XML path searches, filename extraction for HLS, domain/path comparison
